claims.claim_text: The indexed Anne F. Mitcheson is a high-confidence match to the Sherborne alumnae entry for Anne F. Mitcheson (Henry).
claims.evidence_paraphrase: A rare exact name and middle initial are linked directly to OSS service in Washington in an institutional alumnae register.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High confidence from the distinctive exact name, middle initial, and explicit OSS context.
claims.temporal_assessment: The register is chronological but supplies no dates for the wartime assignments.
claims.match_notes: The married-name notation supplies documented variants. The later oil-company job is retained only as excluded identity context.

claims.claim_text: Anne F. Mitcheson performed wartime censorship work in Liverpool, Manchester, and Bermuda before her Washington assignments and OSS service.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The chronological alumnae entry places censorship work before Washington staff work and OSS service.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High confidence from the distinctive exact name, middle initial, and explicit OSS link in the same entry.
claims.temporal_assessment: Documented pre-OSS, but not shown to be the immediately preceding affiliation.
claims.match_notes: The source does not identify the employing censorship authority, so none is inferred.

claims.claim_text: Anne F. Mitcheson probably moved from an unspecified Washington staff assignment with four chiefs of staff into OSS service in Washington.
claims.evidence_excerpt: With four chiefs of staff, Washington. With O.S.S. in Washington.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The register places the Washington chiefs-of-staff entry directly before the OSS entry.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High confidence from the distinctive exact name and explicit OSS context in the same institutional entry.
claims.temporal_assessment: Probable immediate predecessor because the statements are adjacent, but dates and the employing organization are absent.
claims.match_notes: The phrase is preserved as found and is not normalized to the Combined Chiefs of Staff without further evidence.

research_attempts.query_text: Carl W Mitchell; T-4; protected identifier; OSS; employer; occupation
research_attempts.rejection_reasons: Common-name and identifier searches produced no candidate with two corroborating identifiers beyond the name.
research_attempts.research_notes: The minimum official, exact-name OSS, employment, occupation, institutional, newspaper, obituary, and directory protocol was completed. The CIA adapter was blocked by access policy; no authenticated NARA API request was made.

research_attempts.query_text: David H Mitchell; S 2/c; protected identifier; OSS; Navy; employer; occupation
research_attempts.rejection_reasons: Three newspaper candidates were wrong people or lacked the indexed middle initial, naval grade, identifier, and OSS bridge.
research_attempts.research_notes: The full minimum protocol and protected-identifier search were completed. The CIA adapter was blocked by access policy; no authenticated NARA API request was made.

research_attempts.query_text: Denis M Mitchell; Pfc; protected identifier; OSS; employer; occupation
research_attempts.rejection_reasons: No candidate employer supplied a safe wartime identity and chronology bridge.
